features/tasks.title: Keep the task, owner and deadline together.
features/tasks.sub: List, Board, Calendar and Gantt show the same work from different angles.
features/tasks.problem: A status update should not require reconstructing a conversation.

steps.title: Define the task
steps.body: Add the expected result, owner, deadline and dependencies.

steps.title: Choose a view
steps.body: Use a board for flow, a list for detail, or a calendar for upcoming dates.

steps.title: Review the result
steps.body: Follow the activity and attached evidence before marking work accepted.

benefits.title: One task record
benefits.body: Changes remain attached to the work your team tracks.

benefits.title: Views for different decisions
benefits.body: Inspect status, timing and dependencies without maintaining parallel lists.

features/tasks.limits: Agents need a connected runtime to do the work; Operate coordinates that work.

features/agents.title: Give each agent an identity and a bounded assignment.
features/agents.sub: Connect your existing runtime and see who is working on which task.
features/agents.problem: An unnamed script is hard to pause, review or distinguish from another worker.

steps.title: Create an agent
steps.body: Choose its organization boundary and create or authorize credentials.

steps.title: Set the scope
steps.body: Choose allowed lists and access roles before assigning tasks.

steps.title: Observe its activity
steps.body: Use heartbeats and task updates to follow progress, then pause access when needed.

benefits.title: Visible ownership
benefits.body: A task can show which agent holds it.

benefits.title: Revocable access
benefits.body: Pause or revoke credentials without rewriting every task.

features/agents.limits: Presence reflects reported activity. It is not proof of uninterrupted execution or finished work.

features/governance.title: Make review part of the task.
features/governance.sub: Use roles, scopes and approval requirements to define what a connected agent may do in Operate.
features/governance.problem: A prompt asking for caution is not the same as a server-enforced rule.

steps.title: Set access
steps.body: Limit the workspace, lists and read/write role.

steps.title: Require approval
steps.body: Mark work that needs human sign-off before completion.

steps.title: Review evidence
steps.body: Inspect the proposed result and its record before approving.

benefits.title: Clear decision rights
benefits.body: People choose when a task needs review.

benefits.title: Bounded changes
benefits.body: Supported API operations enforce the configured access scope.

features/governance.limits: Operate approval gates govern Operate task actions. Configure separate controls in deployment, email and other external tools.

features/collaboration.title: Hand off work without losing the next step.
features/collaboration.sub: Claims, dependencies and comments help people and agents coordinate on a shared task.
features/collaboration.problem: Two workers can duplicate effort when ownership exists only in a chat message.

steps.title: Claim the task
steps.body: Check the current owner and blockers before starting.

steps.title: Report progress
steps.body: Keep relevant updates and artifacts attached to the task.

steps.title: Release or hand off
steps.body: Leave the result, remaining work and next owner explicit.

benefits.title: Less duplicated effort
benefits.body: A claim makes the active worker visible.

benefits.title: Recoverable handoffs
benefits.body: The next worker can inspect the state instead of guessing.

features/collaboration.limits: Claims expire. The runtime must follow the coordination protocol and report its progress.

features/sprints.title: Turn recurring work into a visible plan.
features/sprints.sub: Organize a sprint, apply a template and keep recurring tasks on the same board.
features/sprints.problem: Repeated work becomes inconsistent when each cycle starts from a blank brief.

steps.title: Set the cycle
steps.body: Choose the period and the work that belongs in it.

steps.title: Apply the process
steps.body: Use list templates, statuses and recurring schedules.

steps.title: Review what changed
steps.body: Compare completed work with the original requirements before the next cycle.

benefits.title: Repeatable structure
benefits.body: Reuse a process without copying a whole chat.

benefits.title: A shared timebox
benefits.body: People and agents can see what is due together.

features/sprints.limits: Scheduling creates and coordinates work; your connected runtime must execute agent assignments.

features/docs.title: Put project instructions beside the work they explain.
features/docs.sub: Keep documents and whiteboards in the workspace where tasks are planned and reviewed.
features/docs.problem: An agent can miss a requirement when the brief lives in a separate tool or inaccessible file.

steps.title: Write the brief
steps.body: State the outcome, constraints and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Link it to work
steps.body: Make the relevant instructions easy to find from the task.

steps.title: Keep it current
steps.body: Update the document when a decision changes and tell the assigned worker.

benefits.title: Less hunting for context
benefits.body: The brief lives near the task.

benefits.title: Reviewable instructions
benefits.body: People can inspect what the agent was asked to do.

features/docs.limits: Connected agents must retrieve current documents. Existing prompts do not automatically refresh.

features/webhooks.title: Let a work event trigger the next step.
features/webhooks.sub: Use signed webhooks or event reads to connect Operate with your own runtime.
features/webhooks.problem: Repeated polling adds work when the useful change is a single assignment or comment.

steps.title: Choose events
steps.body: Subscribe to the changes your integration needs.

steps.title: Verify delivery
steps.body: Validate signatures and handle duplicate or retried delivery.

steps.title: Process the change
steps.body: Fetch the current task and act within its permissions.

benefits.title: Timely handoffs
benefits.body: Your integration can respond when work changes.

benefits.title: A record to inspect
benefits.body: Events support troubleshooting and status reporting.

features/webhooks.limits: Delivery can fail and retry. Consumers need idempotency, signature validation and recovery.

features/mcp.title: Connect your agent to a shared project workspace.
features/mcp.sub: MCP gives compatible tools access to supported Operate tasks, documents and coordination actions.
features/mcp.problem: An agent needs structured access to work, not a screenshot of a task board.

steps.title: Create scoped access
steps.body: Choose an agent identity and permission boundary.

steps.title: Connect the client
steps.body: Use the documented endpoint and authorized credentials for your runtime.

steps.title: Try a bounded task
steps.body: Read a task, report progress and hand back a result for review.

benefits.title: Structured access
benefits.body: Tools retrieve and update the supported product objects.

benefits.title: The same work record
benefits.body: Agent activity appears alongside human work.

features/mcp.limits: Client compatibility, credentials and runtime availability are prerequisites. MCP does not supply the model or hosting.

resources/approval-checklist.title: Write an acceptance checklist before assigning the task.
resources/approval-checklist.sub: Define what a reviewer should inspect so a finished-looking artifact is not mistaken for an accepted result.
resources/approval-checklist.problem: A task marked done does not explain which requirement was verified.

steps.title: Name the result
steps.body: Specify the artifact or behavior and who will use it.

steps.title: Choose evidence
steps.body: Ask for a relevant test, screenshot, document or working link for each requirement.

steps.title: Review independently
steps.body: Check the result against the original criteria and return specific corrections.

benefits.title: Clearer assignments
benefits.body: The worker knows what result matters.

benefits.title: More useful reviews
benefits.body: The reviewer has concrete criteria rather than a general impression.

resources/approval-checklist.limits: A checklist records the acceptance standard. It does not substitute for testing the actual result.

resources/action-budgets.title: Separate coordination actions from model spend.
resources/action-budgets.sub: Operate records and limits actions in its own workspace. The runtime and model provider may have separate costs.
resources/action-budgets.problem: A daily write limit cannot guarantee a dollar ceiling for work happening in an external runtime.

steps.title: Set an action boundary
steps.body: Choose an agent role, scope and daily action limit.

steps.title: Set provider controls
steps.body: Configure spend limits and stop conditions in the runtime that executes the work.

steps.title: Review usage
steps.body: Compare the action record with provider invoices and task evidence.

benefits.title: Clearer budgeting
benefits.body: You know which system controls each cost.

benefits.title: Safer expansion
benefits.body: Increase limits after a bounded workload demonstrates useful results.

resources/action-budgets.limits: Proposed monthly allowances count successful agent writes, not tokens. A production monthly meter and entitlement enforcement are required before these packages can launch.
